notes: All 12 views inspected. Cast-steel head reads correctly from both faces, the knurled adjuster worm and jaw teeth survive the silhouette at 5.4k tris, and the worn wooden handle shows continuous grain around the full orbit. Clay and wireframe confirm even quad-derived triangulation with no shading pinch at the jaw pivot.
limitations: Faint embossed lettering on the shank is a generic size marking, not a readable brand.
Baked-in studio lighting in the albedo makes the steel read slightly flat under strong directional light.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
